summary: Strengthen award controls, partner oversight and audit readiness with practical grant portfolio exercises. Explore the course and plan your training.
lede: Grant portfolio management helps grants, finance and programme leaders coordinate controls across multiple donor awards. The training addresses the practical work of monitoring partner risks, tracking budgets and keeping reporting evidence organized. Participants practise segmenting subrecipient risk, forecasting burn rates in Excel, controlling award changes and preparing closeout and audit records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for controlling donor-funded portfolios, monitoring implementing partners and preparing financial or programme evidence across multiple awards. This course is designed for: Grants managers coordinating award conditions, reporting calendars and lifecycle controls. NGO finance directors reviewing award budgets, expenditure and portfolio-level forecasts. Programme directors reconciling implementation progress with approved grant plans. Donor-compliance officers tracking award conditions, reporting obligations and corrective actions. Subaward managers assessing partner capacity and monitoring subrecipient performance. Internal auditors testing grant controls, transaction evidence and closeout files. Implementing-partner leads preparing expenditure support and responding to grant-monitoring findings. Grant accountants reconciling expenditure, commitments and donor-reported balances. MEAL managers aligning results evidence with donor reporting milestones and award indicators. Procurement officers documenting grant-funded purchasing and linking files to award requirements.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of grant-funded programme or finance operations is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet exercises; Power BI familiarity is not required.
